speaker: 旁白
text: 晚间查房结束，朝仓把明天的手术安排夹回记录板，轻轻合上笔帽。
en: After the evening rounds, Asakura clips tomorrow's operating schedule back onto her clipboard and gently caps her pen.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「好了。今晚如果不舒服就按铃，明天一早还有得忙呢。」
en: “All right. Ring the bell if you feel unwell tonight. We have a busy morning ahead.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「朝仓小姐，等、等一下！」
en: “Miss Asakura, w-wait!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「嗯？二阶堂小姐，还有什么忘了问？」
en: “Hmm? Is there something else you forgot to ask, Miss Nikaido?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 赖子从枕边抽出一本小笔记本。前两页写得满满的，还用红笔画着好几个问号。
en: Yoriko pulls a small notebook from beside her pillow. Its first two pages are crammed with writing, with several question marks drawn in red.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「……哇。你是来住院，还是来做新闻采访呀？」
en: “…Wow. Are you here as a patient, or to conduct an interview?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我不是想打听什么秘密啦！只是……明天真的要轮到我开刀了。」
en: “I'm not trying to dig up any secrets! It's just… tomorrow it really will be my turn to have surgery.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「我知道呀。你昨天已经把术前同意书读了两遍，今天又问了我六遍。」
en: “I know. You read the consent form twice yesterday, and asked me about it six times today.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「哪有六遍！……咦，你连次数都记着？」
en: “It wasn't six times! …Huh? You even kept count?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「记性好是护士的优点哦。」
en: “A good memory is an asset for a nurse.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那我想问最后一个……不对，可能还有几个。」
en: “Then I have one last question… No, maybe a few more.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵。请讲。」
en: “Hehe. Go ahead.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「从明天一早起床，到被送进手术室，再到医生真的拿刀……中间到底会怎么准备？一步都别省。」
en: “From waking up tomorrow morning, to being taken into the operating room, to the doctor actually picking up the knife… what exactly happens to get me ready? Don't skip a single step.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你确定要听得那么仔细？」
en: “Are you sure you want that much detail?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「当然确定。我是警察耶，知道得越清楚，心里才越有底嘛。」
en: “Of course. I'm a police officer! The more I know, the more prepared I'll feel.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「好。那我按时间讲。中途可不许因为害怕，就怪我吓你哦。」
en: “All right. I'll go through it by time. But don't get frightened halfway through and accuse me of scaring you.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「放心啦，我还没胆小到那种程度。」
en: “Don't worry. I'm not that much of a scaredy-cat.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓拉过一把椅子，坐在床边，把记录板放到膝上。她的表情像是有人终于问到了她最擅长的话题。
en: Asakura pulls up a chair beside the bed and rests the clipboard on her lap. Her expression suggests someone has finally asked about her favorite subject.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「明天五点半左右，护士就来叫你起床。」
en: “A nurse will wake you at around five thirty tomorrow.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「五点半？！我以为手术九点开始，睡到七点也来得及。」
en: “Five thirty?! I thought surgery started at nine. Surely I could sleep until seven.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「九点是开刀时间呀，不是你睁眼起床的时间。」
en: “Nine is when the incision begins, not when you open your eyes.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……这种区别你为什么讲得那么开心？」
en: “…Why do you sound so happy explaining that distinction?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「因为很多人都会弄错。先量体温、血压、脉搏，确认腕带、姓名、术式、禁食时间和过敏情况。」
en: “Because lots of people get it wrong. First we'll check your temperature, blood pressure and pulse, then confirm your wristband, name, procedure, fasting time and allergies.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「可是这些今天已经问过啦！」
en: “But you already asked all that today!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「明天还会问。到了手术区，问得更多。」
en: “We'll ask again tomorrow. And even more once you reach the surgical area.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你们是有多怕把我认错呀？」
en: “How worried are you about mistaking me for someone else?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「二阶堂小姐，你当警察抓人，也不能因为‘这张脸很眼熟’，就省略身份确认吧？」
en: “Miss Nikaido, when you arrest someone, you can't skip checking their identity just because their face looks familiar, can you?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那当然不能！……可是被人像嫌疑人一样反复问名字，还是怪怪的。」
en: “Of course not! …But being asked my name over and over like a suspect still feels strange.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「然后是清洁、备皮，戴好手术帽。眼镜、首饰、发夹都要收好，头发全部塞进帽子里。」
en: “Then there's cleaning, skin preparation and putting on your surgical cap. Glasses, jewelry and hair clips are put away, and all your hair goes inside the cap.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「眼镜也不能戴？没有眼镜，我连你们的脸都看不清！」
en: “I can't even wear my glasses? I can't make out your faces without them!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「手术室里本来就人人戴帽子口罩，你有眼镜也不一定认得出来呀。」
en: “Everyone in the operating room wears a cap and mask anyway. You might not recognize us even with your glasses.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「这算哪门子的安慰啊！」
en: “How is that supposed to be reassuring?!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「哦，还有，病号服和自己的衣物都要脱下。之后会用毯单盖好，不会让你就那么走过走廊。」
en: “Oh, and your hospital gown and your own clothes all come off. We'll cover you with a blanket afterward. We won't have you going down the corridor like that.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……等一下。你刚才说，病号服也脱？」
en: “…Wait. Did you just say the hospital gown comes off too?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「嗯。手术时需要按范围清洁、消毒和铺无菌单。私人内衣也不留在下面。」
en: “Yes. The area needed for surgery has to be cleaned, disinfected and draped. Your own underwear won't be left underneath either.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「连、连内衣都没有？我早上起床以后就要变成那个样子？」
en: “N-not even underwear? That's what I'll be like after I get up tomorrow?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「该遮盖的地方会遮好。只在检查或准备需要时露出相应部位。对我们来说，这是很普通的术前工作。」
en: “We'll keep you covered where you should be. Only the area needed for an examination or preparation will be exposed. It's ordinary preoperative work for us.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你越说‘很普通’，我就越觉得不好意思……」
en: “The more you call it ‘ordinary,’ the more embarrassed I feel…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「可你不是说，一步也别省吗？」
en: “But weren't you the one who said not to skip a single step?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……好啦。继续。」
en: “…Fine. Go on.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「五点多到六点之间，会请你最后一次去洗手间。之后一切移动都需要让护士帮忙，不能想起来就穿拖鞋往外跑。」
en: “Sometime between five and six, we'll have you use the bathroom one last time. After that, you'll need a nurse's help whenever you move. You can't just slip on your slippers and wander out.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我又不是小孩子！……只是，如果中途又想上厕所呢？」
en: “I'm not a child! …But what if I need the bathroom again later?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「告诉我们。你这次是较长的腹部手术，术中排尿会按计划处理，后面还要导尿。」
en: “Tell us. This is a fairly long abdominal operation, so we'll manage urine drainage according to plan. Catheterization comes later.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「导、导尿也在日程表里？！」
en: “C-catheterization is on the schedule too?!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「当然。你今晚是不是把‘术前准备’四个字想得太简单啦？」
en: “Of course. Were you imagining ‘preoperative preparation’ was something much simpler?”

speaker: 旁白
text: 赖子的耳朵红了。她本来想把笔记本合上，犹豫片刻，又把书页翻开。
en: Yoriko's ears turn red. She starts to close her notebook, hesitates, then opens it again.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那、那这个……是在我清醒的时候做？」
en: “Th-then… will I be awake for that?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「按目前计划，会先做好硬膜外麻醉，确认效果后再完成这部分准备。你有感觉或不舒服，随时说。」
en: “The current plan is to give you the epidural first, confirm it is working, and then finish that part of the preparation. Tell us whenever you feel anything or are uncomfortable.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
en: “Oh…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「怎么？突然不记笔记了？」
en: “What is it? Suddenly stopped taking notes?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「这个我用脑子记住就好了啦！」
en: “I can remember that part without writing it down!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「六点左右再确认输液、病历、影像和手术同意书。所有资料都会跟着你去手术室。」
en: “Around six, we'll recheck the IV, your medical records, images and surgical consent form. All the documentation goes to the operating room with you.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我自己也跟着去，是吧？」
en: “And I go along too, right?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「当然呀。不带患者，医生要给谁开刀？」
en: “Of course. Who would the doctor operate on without the patient?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我知道！我只是……想确认一下！」
en: “I know! I just… wanted to make sure!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「之后上转运车，盖好毯子，由护士推着走。到了手术区门口，再做一次交接。」
en: “Then you'll get onto the trolley, with the blanket tucked around you, and a nurse will wheel you over. There'll be another handover at the entrance to the surgical area.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我要一直躺着被推过去？不能自己走吗？」
en: “I have to lie there while you wheel me all the way? I can't walk?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你当时已经完成术前准备，还有管路和遮盖要照顾。安心躺好，护士负责推。」
en: “You'll already be prepared for surgery, with lines and coverings to look after. Just lie comfortably and leave the pushing to the nurse.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你们真是打算让我从早上开始，一路躺到手术结束啊……」
en: “You really intend to keep me lying down from morning until the operation is over…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「本来就是这样。七点入室，手术台会比你现在这张床窄一点、硬一点。」
en: “That's how it works. You'll enter the room at seven. The operating table is a little narrower and firmer than this bed.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「窄到什么程度？」
en: “How narrow?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「足够让医生从两边靠近工作。会铺垫子，也会摆好头、肩膀、手臂和双腿的位置。」
en: “Narrow enough for the doctors to work from both sides. We'll put down padding and position your head, shoulders, arms and legs.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「听上去像是在摆一件……很重要的证物。」
en: “That sounds like arranging a piece of… very important evidence.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵，你终于找到一个警察能用上的比喻了。不过证物不会自己突然打喷嚏，我们还得提醒你怎么配合。」
en: “Hehe, you've finally found a police comparison. But evidence doesn't suddenly sneeze by itself. We still have to tell you how to help us.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我真的有那么不可靠吗？」
en: “Am I really that unreliable?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你是个很会聊天的患者呀。只是移动体位时，最好先听口令。要帮你挪动的时候，几名护士会一起喊‘一、二、三’，然后再挪。」
en: “You're a very talkative patient. But when we change your position, it's best to wait for instructions. Several nurses will count ‘one, two, three’ together before moving you.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……连我躺在哪里，都不是自己决定了。」
en: “…I don't even get to decide where I lie.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「因为那时你正在接受手术准备。你可以提出不舒服，但不能自己翻过身去重新躺好。」
en: “Because you'll be undergoing surgical preparation. You can tell us if you're uncomfortable, but you can't roll over and settle yourself into another position.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「不会让我掉下去吧？」
en: “You won't let me fall, will you?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「会有安全带、垫子和支托。是为了防止滑动或压伤，不是把你当行李绑在架子上。」
en: “There'll be safety straps, padding and supports. They're there to prevent sliding and pressure injuries, not to tie you to a rack like luggage.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你不觉得，最后这个比喻比不说还吓人吗？」
en: “Don't you think that last comparison made it scarier than saying nothing?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「不然你想听医学术语版？」
en: “Would you prefer the medical terminology?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……还是算了。」
en: “…Never mind.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「上台以后，胸前贴心电电极、手臂缠血压袖带，手指夹血氧探头，输液管路固定在安全位置。房间里会有人不停看监测。」
en: “Once you're on the table, we'll put ECG electrodes on your chest, a blood-pressure cuff around your arm, a pulse-oximeter probe on your finger, and secure the IV line safely. Someone in the room will keep watching the monitors.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「所以那个时候，除了自己以外，我身上会有一大堆东西？」
en: “So by then I'll have a whole pile of things attached to me?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「嗯。大家都是为了让你安全做手术。」
en: “Yes. Everyone is working to keep you safe during surgery.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……朝仓小姐，你每次讲出‘安全’两个字，后面就会多出一种我不知道的东西。」
en: “…Miss Asakura, every time you say ‘safe,’ another thing I've never heard of turns up.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓笑得眼睛弯了起来，像是被赖子这个发现逗乐了。
en: Asakura's eyes curve with her smile, as though Yoriko's discovery has amused her.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「七点多，南条医生会和你核对情况，然后做硬膜外麻醉。」
en: “Sometime after seven, Dr. Nanjo will check everything with you, then administer the epidural.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「就是……从背后扎针、放一根管子的那个？」
en: “That's… the one with a needle in your back and a tube?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「是。需要你侧身或坐好，保持姿势。医生会先解释，再进行操作。」
en: “Yes. You'll need to lie on your side or sit up, then hold that position. The doctor will explain before doing anything.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我明明是肚子要开刀，为什么先在背后打针……」
en: “It's my abdomen that needs surgery. Why do I get a needle in my back first…?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「因为麻醉阻滞的是神经传来的感觉，不一定直接打在切口上。完成后还要测试范围，确认足够才能开始手术。」
en: “Because anesthesia blocks sensation carried by the nerves. It doesn't always go directly into the incision site. Afterward, we'll test the area of numbness. Surgery can only start once it's sufficient.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「所以我不是闭眼睡一觉，再醒过来就做完了？」
en: “So I won't just close my eyes, sleep, and wake up when it's finished?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「按这次计划，不是哦。你原则上会保持清醒。南条医生会一直监测，必要时调整方案。真正的尖锐疼痛要马上报告，阻滞不充分就先处理，不是叫你忍着。」
en: “Not according to this plan. Generally, you'll remain awake. Dr. Nanjo will keep monitoring you and adjust the plan if needed. Tell us immediately about any actual sharp pain. If the block is insufficient, we'll address it first, not ask you to endure it.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……我会一直醒着，知道大家在对我做什么？」
en: “…I'll be awake the whole time, knowing what everyone is doing to me?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「能知道不少事情。布单铺好以后，你看不到腹部的操作，但能听到一些声音。」
en: “You'll be aware of quite a lot. Once the drapes are in place, you won't see the work on your abdomen, but you'll hear some sounds.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
en: “…Sounds?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「器械包装拆开的声音，金属器械放上托盘的声音，护士互相核对的声音。有人报监测数据，有人问灯的位置，有人检查吸引器。」
en: “Instrument packs being opened, metal instruments placed on trays, nurses checking things with one another. Someone reporting readings, someone asking about the light, someone checking the suction.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「先、先停！我好像已经听见了！」
en: “S-stop a moment! I feel like I can hear it already!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓真的停下，安静地看着她。赖子捂住耳朵，过了两秒，又慢慢把手放下来。
en: Asakura really does stop and watches her quietly. Yoriko covers her ears, then slowly lowers her hands two seconds later.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
en: “…And then?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「咦？刚刚不是说停吗？」
en: “Huh? Didn't you just say stop?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我是说暂停一下！不是叫你把后面的都省略！」
en: “I meant pause! Not skip everything that comes afterward!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「原来如此。你是那种看恐怖片会捂住眼睛，然后又从指缝偷看的人。」
en: “I see. You're the sort who covers her eyes during a horror movie, then peeks through her fingers.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「这不是电影！明天亲自躺在那上面的是我！」
en: “This isn't a movie! I'm the one who'll actually be lying there tomorrow!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「是呀。所以我才特别认真地说明嘛。」
en: “Exactly. That's why I'm explaining it so carefully.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你该不会……有一点享受讲这些吧？」
en: “You don't… enjoy talking about this a little, do you?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「有呀。把人、器械、麻醉、时间和位置全部安排得好好的，是一台手术很有意思的地方。」
en: “I do. Getting the people, instruments, anesthesia, timing and positions all properly organized is one of the interesting parts of an operation.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「对你们来说有意思。对我来说……」
en: “Interesting for you. For me…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你就是明天整个手术室的中心人物呢。」
en: “You'll be the center of attention in the whole operating room tomorrow.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「中心人物？！不要用这么像‘主角登场’的说法啊！」
en: “The center of attention?! Don't make it sound like the star is making her entrance!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「可是没错呀。主刀的坂口医生、负责麻醉的南条医生、管器械的中井小姐，还有巡回护士……大家都在为你的手术准备。」
en: “But it's true. Dr. Sakaguchi, the surgeon; Dr. Nanjo, handling anesthesia; Miss Nakai, handling instruments; and the circulating nurse… everyone will be preparing for your operation.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……一个房间的人，全都围着我转？」
en: “…An entire room of people, all bustling around me?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「对。你可以很放心地交给我们。」
en: “Yes. You can leave it to us with confidence.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你怎么把最吓人的一句话，讲得像是在夸奖我！」
en: “How do you make the scariest sentence sound like a compliment?!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「七点半之后，还有导尿、腹部消毒、体位微调和各种准备。护士会按需要揭开相应的遮盖，再重新盖好。」
en: “After seven thirty, there'll be catheterization, abdominal disinfection, small adjustments to your position and various other preparations. The nurses will uncover the relevant area as needed, then cover it again.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「消毒会消多大一块？」
en: “How big an area will you disinfect?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「会比最终切口的范围大。下腹部要充分消毒，消毒液可能有一点凉，不过麻醉后你未必能像平时那样感觉到。」
en: “Larger than the eventual incision. Your lower abdomen needs thorough disinfection. The solution may feel a little cool, though after anesthesia you might not feel it the way you normally would.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……所以你们还会把我身上的毯子掀开，然后认真盯着我肚子做准备。」
en: “…So you'll lift the blanket off me, then look closely at my abdomen while getting things ready.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「当然。要确认消毒范围、体位、皮肤和线路的位置。这是工作。」
en: “Of course. We have to check the disinfected area, your position, the skin and where the lines are. It's our work.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你们一直说‘工作’。我明明连衣服都没穿，还要躺着让一群人围过来……」
en: “You keep saying ‘work.’ I'll be lying there without any clothes while a whole group gathers around…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「因为对我们来说确实很普通。没有谁是专门跑进来欣赏二阶堂小姐害怕的。」
en: “Because it really is ordinary for us. Nobody is coming in specially to admire how frightened Miss Nikaido looks.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「哇啊……你说得好自然，反而让我更羞耻了！」
en: “Waaah… You say that so naturally, it makes me even more embarrassed!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「咦？为什么？」
en: “Oh? Why?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「因为只有我觉得这是一件不得了的大事！你们却觉得‘好，下一项’！」
en: “Because I'm the only one who thinks this is a huge deal! You're all just thinking, ‘Right, next item!’”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那明天你就会亲自见识我们的‘下一项’有多可靠了。」
en: “Then tomorrow you'll see for yourself just how dependable our ‘next item’ is.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……你这句话到底是安慰，还是预告？」
en: “…Is that meant to reassure me, or warn me what's coming?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「两个都有一点。」
en: “A little of both.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓故意学着赖子刚才犹犹豫豫的语气，笑了。赖子鼓起脸颊，偏偏没办法反驳。
en: Asakura deliberately imitates Yoriko's earlier hesitant tone and laughs. Yoriko puffs out her cheeks, but has no reply.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「八点左右开始铺无菌单。需要露出的手术区域留在洞巾中央，其他部位都盖住。铺好以后，你几乎看不到自己腹部那边的工作了。」
en: “We'll start placing sterile drapes around eight. The surgical area that needs to be exposed stays in the center opening; everything else is covered. Afterward, you'll hardly be able to see any of the work around your abdomen.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「所以我会听见你们说话，却看不见你们在做什么？」
en: “So I'll hear you talking, but I won't see what you're doing?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「多数时候是这样。想闭眼就闭眼，想看无影灯就看灯。没有规定患者必须睁着眼睛看热闹。」
en: “Most of the time. Close your eyes if you like, or look at the surgical lights. There's no rule that patients must keep their eyes open to watch the excitement.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「可是看不见的话，我可能会一直猜啊！」
en: “But if I can't see, I might keep guessing!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你可以问。我们会把能告诉你的工作步骤说清楚。」
en: “You can ask. We'll explain the steps we can tell you about.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那如果我冷呢？」
en: “What if I'm cold?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「说冷。」
en: “Say you're cold.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「如果手臂被固定得不舒服呢？」
en: “What if my arm feels uncomfortable where it's secured?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「说不舒服，我们会检查能不能调整。」
en: “Tell us it feels uncomfortable. We'll check whether we can adjust it.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「如果我想坐起来看看？」
en: “What if I want to sit up and look?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「先告诉我们，别自己起来。那时可能已经接着管路、完成麻醉了。」
en: “Tell us first. Don't get up by yourself. You may already have lines connected and anesthesia in effect.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「如果我忽然觉得自己不想做手术了？」
en: “What if I suddenly decide I don't want the operation?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「如果你要改变手术决定，就要马上告诉医生，我们会重新确认。害怕和改变决定不是一回事，哪一种都别瞒着。」
en: “If you want to change your decision, tell the doctor immediately so we can confirm it again. Being frightened and changing your decision aren't the same thing. Don't hide either.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……那如果我只是看见手术刀，突然想逃回病房呢？」
en: “…And what if I just see the scalpel and suddenly want to run back to my room?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「至少先说出来嘛。我们能帮你处理紧张，不能在你没开口的时候猜中你每个逃跑计划。」
en: “At least tell us first. We can help with your nerves, but we can't guess every escape plan before you say anything.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你刚才明明猜中了我一大堆问题！」
en: “You just guessed a whole bunch of my questions!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那是因为二阶堂小姐真的很容易懂呀。」
en: “That's because you're really very easy to read, Miss Nikaido.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「八点半左右，中井小姐会再清点一次器械和纱布，医生对照影像确认今天要处理的几个肌瘤位置。」
en: “Around eight thirty, Miss Nakai will count the instruments and gauze again, while the doctors check the images to confirm the locations of the fibroids being treated.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……好几个啊。」
en: “…Several of them.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「是。你这次不是取出一个小东西就结束。主刀会逐个处理不同位置的肌瘤，最后仔细修复子宫壁。手术时间会比普通的小手术长。」
en: “Yes. This isn't a matter of removing one little thing and finishing. The surgeon will deal with the fibroids in each location, then carefully repair the uterine wall. It will take longer than an ordinary minor operation.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你说‘逐个处理’的时候，我突然感觉自己肚子里好像排了一整张工作清单。」
en: “When you say ‘each location,’ I suddenly feel like there's a whole to-do list inside my abdomen.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「这形容不错。术前影像和手术计划，确实要一项一项对。」
en: “That's a good description. We really do have to check the preoperative images and surgical plan item by item.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「可是我明明是个人，为什么能被你说得像在处理一宗复杂案件……」
en: “But I'm a person. Why do you make me sound like a complicated investigation…?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你可以理解成我们在替你解决一桩很麻烦的案子。不过这次你是最重要的证人，得安心躺好。」
en: “You can think of it as us solving a very troublesome case for you. But this time you're the most important witness, so you need to lie quietly.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……当证人原来是这么辛苦的工作呀。」
en: “…I never knew being a witness was such hard work.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「接着，南条医生最后确认阻滞范围，坂口医生准备在切口位置补局部浸润麻醉。大家完成手术开始前的核对。」
en: “Next, Dr. Nanjo will make a final check of the block, and Dr. Sakaguchi will prepare additional local infiltration at the incision site. Everyone will complete the checks before surgery begins.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「不是都硬膜外麻醉了吗？怎么切口还要再打？」
en: “But I'll already have an epidural! Why inject the incision site too?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「是补充。处理切口的感觉，和身体深处的牵拉感不是完全一样的事。南条医生会持续评估，确认足够才让坂口医生开始。」
en: “It's a supplement. Sensation around the incision isn't quite the same as pulling sensations deep inside. Dr. Nanjo will continue assessing you and only let Dr. Sakaguchi start once the anesthesia is sufficient.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……我会听见他们一起说我的名字吗？」
en: “…Will I hear them all say my name?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「会。大家要确认患者、术式、部位、麻醉状态和特别要注意的事情。到那时，你会发现整间手术室忽然安静下来，认真听每个人回答。」
en: “Yes. Everyone must confirm the patient, procedure, site, anesthetic status and anything needing special attention. You'll notice the whole room suddenly quiet down to listen carefully to each person's response.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我已经开始想象那个声音了……」
en: “I'm already imagining what that sounds like…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「九点左右，主刀确认准备完毕，助手就位，中井小姐递上第一把手术刀。然后——」
en: “At around nine, the surgeon confirms that preparation is complete, the assistant takes position, and Miss Nakai passes over the first scalpel. Then—”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「停！停！先不要讲！」
en: “Stop! Stop! Don't say it yet!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 赖子一把拉高被子，眼镜都歪了。朝仓真的住口，还体贴地等她把眼镜扶正。
en: Yoriko yanks up the blanket so abruptly that her glasses tilt. Asakura really does fall silent, and considerately waits for her to straighten them.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「不是说要一直听到下刀吗？」
en: “Didn't you say you wanted to hear everything up to the incision?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我想听！可是你讲得……太像真的了！」
en: “I do! But you make it sound… far too real!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「因为明天就是真的呀。」
en: “Because tomorrow it will be real.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「不要用那么开心的表情说出来！」
en: “Don't say that with such a happy face!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那我可以从‘中井小姐递上第一把手术刀’那里继续。」
en: “Then I can continue from ‘Miss Nakai passes over the first scalpel.’”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「不、不行！」
en: “N-no!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵。二阶堂小姐，你真是把恐怖片看到最可怕的地方，又舍不得把电视关掉的类型。」
en: “Hehe. You really are the kind who gets to the scariest part of a horror movie and still can't bear to turn off the television.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「都说了这是我的手术，不是恐怖片啦！！」
en: “I keep telling you, this is my operation, not a horror movie!!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「好。那我先不讲后面。」
en: “All right. I won't go any further for now.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 她合上手术安排表。房间安静下来，赖子反而又看了看那本笔记本。
en: She closes the operating schedule. The room falls quiet, and Yoriko finds herself looking at her notebook again.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……可是，你还有没有漏讲的？」
en: “…But is there anything you haven't told me?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「咦？你不是已经叫我停了吗？」
en: “Huh? Didn't you already tell me to stop?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我就是想确认一下啦！越听越可怕，可是如果不知道，我脑子里又会自己想得更可怕。」
en: “I just want to make sure! The more I hear, the scarier it gets, but if I don't know, my imagination makes it even worse.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「原来如此。你平时负责打听别人的消息，今天却是别人比你更清楚你的事。」
en: “I see. Usually you're the one finding out about other people, but today other people know more about what's happening to you than you do.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「对！整间手术室都知道，下一步要怎么处理我。只有我自己躺在那里，什么都做不了……」
en: “Exactly! The whole operating room knows what they're going to do with me next. I'm the only one lying there, unable to do anything…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那就让我们负责忙。你负责把不舒服的地方说出来，配合该配合的部分。」
en: “Then let us do the work. Your job is to tell us what's uncomfortable and cooperate when we need you to.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「也就是说，你们负责准备、消毒、麻醉、开刀……我负责挨刀？」
en: “So you're in charge of preparation, disinfection, anesthesia and cutting… and I'm in charge of getting cut?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你可以换个比较好听的说法，叫‘接受手术’。」
en: “You could use the nicer expression: ‘undergoing surgery.’”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「可从患者角度看，不就是我负责挨刀吗？」
en: “But from the patient's point of view, isn't getting cut exactly my job?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「从患者角度来说……嗯，确实是这样呢。」
en: “From the patient's point of view… yes, I suppose it is.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你至少假装否认一下啊！」
en: “At least pretend to disagree!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓终于笑出了声。赖子也跟着笑了，却还用力抓着被角。
en: Asakura finally laughs aloud. Yoriko laughs with her, though she is still clutching the corner of the blanket tightly.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那明天，如果我真的吓到一句话都说不出来……你会告诉我现在做到哪一步吗？」
en: “Then tomorrow, if I'm really too frightened to say anything… will you tell me which step you're at?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「会。需要你配合的时候也会提前告诉你。」
en: “Yes. And we'll tell you in advance when we need you to cooperate.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「连麻醉、导尿、消毒、铺单都告诉我？」
en: “Even the anesthesia, catheterization, disinfection and draping?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「能告诉的都会告诉。你不想听的，也可以让我先不讲。」
en: “We'll tell you everything we can. If there's something you'd rather not hear, you can ask me to hold off.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「还有一件事。明天你不要突然说‘好了’。」
en: “One more thing. Don't suddenly say ‘All done’ tomorrow.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「为什么？」
en: “Why?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「因为你们每次说‘好了’，都代表接下来又要做一件更可怕的事！」
en: “Because every time you say ‘All done,’ it means you're about to do something even scarier!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那我说准确一点。‘硬膜外麻醉完成’、‘消毒完成’、‘铺单完成’、‘最后核对完成’……」
en: “Then I'll be more precise. ‘Epidural complete,’ ‘Disinfection complete,’ ‘Draping complete,’ ‘Final checks complete’…”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……你看！这样明明更可怕！」
en: “…See?! That's even scarier!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「至少准确呀。」
en: “At least it's precise.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你们护士是不是都这么喜欢，把别人害怕的事情按顺序讲清楚？」
en: “Do all you nurses enjoy explaining the things people fear, step by step?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「当然。这就是我们的工作。何况你问得这么认真，我也不好意思漏掉一项嘛。」
en: “Of course. That's our job. Besides, you're asking so earnestly that I'd feel bad leaving anything out.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我今晚大概要梦见手术台了。」
en: “I'll probably dream about the operating table tonight.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那就当提前熟悉环境。早点睡吧，二阶堂小姐。」
en: “Think of it as getting familiar with the surroundings. Get some sleep, Miss Nikaido.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……如果我明天又开始怕，你可不许嫌我问题多。」
en: “…If I get scared again tomorrow, don't complain that I ask too many questions.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「我什么时候嫌过呢？你想问就问。不过明天说到‘开始’的时候，我可不会让医生为了等你写完笔记停下来哦。」
en: “When have I ever complained? Ask whatever you like. But when we say ‘start’ tomorrow, I won't make the doctor pause until you've finished your notes.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我才不会真的在手术台上记笔记啦！」
en: “I'm not actually going to take notes on the operating table!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「嗯。明天五点半叫你，七点上台，八点铺单，九点开始。每一步我们都会替你记得清清楚楚。」
en: “Right. We'll wake you at five thirty, put you on the table at seven, drape you at eight, and start at nine. We'll remember every step for you.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓站起身，走到门口，仍然带着那种很职业、很满意的微笑。
en: Asakura stands and walks to the door, still wearing that professional, deeply satisfied smile.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……我现在觉得，最可怕的就是你们真的什么都记得。」
en: “…Now I think the scariest part is that you really do remember everything.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 门轻轻合上。赖子关掉床头灯，笔记本已经压在枕边。过了好一会儿，她又摸索着把本子翻到写着「九点」的那一页。
en: The door closes softly. Yoriko switches off the bedside lamp, her notebook already tucked beside her pillow. A long time later, she feels for it again and opens it to the page marked “nine o'clock.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 五点半。值班护士敲门的时候，赖子已经醒了。她望着枕边的笔记本，居然一点也不想再翻。
en: Five thirty. When the nurse on duty knocks, Yoriko is already awake. She looks at the notebook beside her pillow and finds she has no desire to open it again.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……昨天只是听她讲。今天真的到我了。」
en: “…Yesterday I was only listening to her. Today it's really my turn.”

speaker: 值班护士
text: 「二阶堂小姐，早上好。先核对一下姓名和今天的手术。」
en: “Good morning, Miss Nikaido. First, let's confirm your name and today's procedure.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 一连串确认、清洁和备皮之后，病号服与私人衣物被收好，毯单仔细盖在赖子身上。手术帽完全收住她的头发，眼镜也放进物品袋。
en: After a series of checks, cleaning and skin preparation, her hospital gown and personal clothes are put away, and a blanket is carefully laid over her. Her surgical cap contains all her hair; her glasses go into the belongings bag too.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……朝仓小姐昨天说的，连顺序都没错。」
en: “…Everything Miss Asakura said yesterday. Even the order is exactly right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 等赖子反应过来，自己已经躺在转运车上。一个护士推车，一个护士照看管路，走廊里传来一声又一声交接确认。
en: Before Yoriko quite realizes it, she is lying on a trolley. One nurse pushes, another watches the lines, and handover confirmations echo along the corridor.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「等一下，我刚才还在病房里吧？」
en: “Wait, wasn't I just in my room?”

speaker: 值班护士
text: 「是。现在去手术区，马上到七点了。」
en: “Yes. We're heading to the surgical area now. It's almost seven.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……七点。接下来还有两个小时呀。」
en: “…Seven. So there are still two hours to go.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 七点整。手术室门打开，灯光映在天花板上。熟悉的眼睛从一顶手术帽、一副口罩之间向她弯起。
en: Seven sharp. The operating-room door opens, and light reflects off the ceiling. Familiar eyes smile at her between a surgical cap and a mask.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「早上好，二阶堂小姐。昨晚睡得怎么样？」
en: “Good morning, Miss Nikaido. How did you sleep?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「朝仓小姐！我昨晚梦见你一直报时间……可是现在真的七点了！」
en: “Miss Asakura! I dreamed you kept announcing the time… and now it really is seven!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵。那接下来两小时，还请多关照。」
en: “Hehe. Then I'll be looking after you for the next two hours.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你这么说，我又开始觉得时间会长得不得了了……」
en: “When you put it like that, it sounds like it's going to take forever again…”

speaker: 旁白
text: 还没来得及想下去，护士们已经扶她移上窄窄的手术台。有人确认手臂的位置，有人接监测，有人检查输液管路。
en: Before she can dwell on it, the nurses are helping her onto the narrow operating table. Someone checks the position of her arms, someone connects the monitors, and someone checks the IV line.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「啊，真的好窄……等一下，刚才是心电图？接下来又是什么？」
en: “Ah, it really is narrow… Wait, was that the ECG? What's next?”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「血压袖带、血氧监测。刚才那边还叫你回答名字呢。」
en: “The blood-pressure cuff and oxygen monitor. Someone over there was asking you to say your name just now too.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「我听见了！我都快变成会自动回答自己名字的机器啦！」
en: “I heard! I'm turning into a machine that automatically answers with my own name!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵。对了，二阶堂小姐，躺在这里感觉怎么样？」
en: “Hehe. By the way, Miss Nikaido, how does it feel lying here?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「说出来有点怪……我现在明明光光地躺着，只盖着毯子，可是……」
en: “This might sound strange… I'm lying here with nothing on, just a blanket, but…”

speaker: 旁白
text: 心电监测的提示音有规律地响着，血压袖带隔一会儿便轻轻收紧她的手臂，再慢慢松开。赖子听得十分专注。
en: The ECG beeps steadily. Every so often the blood-pressure cuff gently tightens around her arm, then slowly releases. Yoriko listens intently.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那些‘哔、哔’的声音，还有血压带一下下收紧的感觉……好有临场感！啊，我真的在手术室里了！」
en: “Those beeps, and the cuff tightening again and again… It all feels so immediate! Ah, I'm really in an operating room!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「原来二阶堂小姐喜欢这种感觉呀。跟平时听警车的无线电不太一样吧？」
en: “So you like that feeling. A little different from listening to the radio in a police car, isn't it?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「一点也不一样！平时我是在赶去现场的人……今天我却成了现场的中心人物。咦，怎么说着说着还有点激动了！」
en: “Completely different! Usually I'm the one heading to the scene… Today I'm the person at its center. Huh, now that I say it, I'm even getting a little excited!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 南条小夜香来到台边，核对姓名并解释硬膜外麻醉。朝仓在赖子听得见的位置照看着，准备协助调整体位。
en: Sayaka Nanjo comes to the table, confirms her name and explains the epidural. Asakura stays within earshot, ready to help adjust Yoriko's position.

speaker: 南条小夜香
text: 「二阶堂小姐，我是南条，今天负责麻醉。先跟我侧过身来，背稍微弓一点……对，很好。不舒服就告诉我。」
en: “Miss Nikaido, I'm Nanjo, handling your anesthesia today. Turn onto your side with me, and curve your back a little… Yes, very good. Tell me if you're uncomfortable.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「呜……昨晚一听这个就很怕。可现在大家都在跟我讲话，我反倒来不及胡思乱想。」
en: “Ugh… Just hearing about this last night scared me. But now everyone's talking to me, I hardly have time to imagine things.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「那就跟着南条医生的提示慢慢呼吸。需要你配合时，我们会说清楚。」
en: “Then follow Dr. Nanjo's instructions and breathe slowly. We'll tell you clearly whenever we need your help.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 七点四十分。麻醉完成，南条确认阻滞范围，巡回护士继续照看监测。随后是导尿、调整体位和重新整理遮盖；动作一直有人解释，也一直有人接着做下一件事。
en: Seven forty. The epidural is complete. Nanjo checks the area of the block while the circulating nurse continues watching the monitors. Then come catheterization, positioning and rearranging the coverings; someone explains each action, and someone is always moving on to the next task.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「昨天光听你讲这一段，我脸都快烧起来了……今天居然已经做完了？」
en: “Just hearing you describe this part yesterday made my face burn… and today it's already finished?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「欸，朝仓小姐，我忽然想到。脱光衣服，进到一个几乎都是陌生人的地方……有点像第一次去温泉耶。」
en: “Miss Asakura, something just occurred to me. Taking off all your clothes and going somewhere full of people you barely know… it's a bit like your first trip to a hot spring.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵，温泉？这么说，你确实是先洗干净，换了地方，周围的人也都觉得很自然呢。」
en: “Hehe, a hot spring? Well, you did wash first, move somewhere else, and everyone around you treats it as perfectly natural.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「对吧！我刚才甚至觉得，反正大家都是一副见怪不怪的样子，好像我也不用那么不好意思了。」
en: “Exactly! Just now I even thought that since everyone seems so used to it, maybe I don't need to feel so embarrassed.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 赖子下意识地想翻一下身。安全固定带、手臂支托和连接着的监测管线，让她立刻想起自己现在躺在哪里。
en: Yoriko instinctively tries to turn a little. The safety strap, arm supports and connected monitoring lines immediately remind her where she is lying.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……直到我被捆起来，动弹不得！等、等等，哪家温泉会把客人绑在躺椅上啊？！」
en: “…Until I got tied up and couldn't move! W-wait, what hot spring ties its guests to lounge chairs?!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「是防止滑动的安全固定啦，不是捆人。不过……温泉里应该也不会有这么多工作人员，只围着你一个人忙吧？」
en: “It's safety support to prevent slipping, not tying you up. Though… I doubt a hot spring has quite so many staff all attending to just you.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「你说得很有道理……可是为什么一点也安慰不到我？！」
en: “That makes perfect sense… so why doesn't it reassure me at all?!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你刚才配合得很好哦。现在还有哪里不舒服？」
en: “You've been doing very well. Is anything uncomfortable now?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「有点冷，还有……眼镜拿走之后，你们每个人的脸都模模糊糊的。」
en: “I'm a little cold, and… without my glasses, everyone's face is blurry.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「好，我帮你调整保温。脸虽然看不清，声音总还认得出来吧？」
en: “All right, I'll adjust the warming. You may not see our faces clearly, but you can still recognize our voices, can't you?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「认得！特别是某个总喜欢把可怕的事讲得很开心的护士！」
en: “I can! Especially one particular nurse who always sounds so happy describing frightening things!”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「咦？我怎么觉得是在夸我呢。」
en: “Oh? Somehow that sounds like a compliment.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 八点多。器械包装的声音、中井美佳核对器械与纱布数量的声音、医生讨论影像和手术范围的声音，一阵接着一阵。赖子一会儿看向左边，一会儿又被右边的人叫住。
en: After eight. The sound of instrument packs opening, Mika Nakai checking instrument and gauze counts, and doctors discussing images and the scope of surgery follows one after another. Yoriko looks left, only for someone on her right to call to her.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「那边在数什么？……啊，好的，我这只手不动。咦，现在又要调整灯了吗？」
en: “What are they counting over there? …Ah, all right, I'll keep this hand still. Huh, are you adjusting the light now?”

speaker: 中井美佳
text: 「在核对器械和纱布，数量一项都不能错。二阶堂小姐，这部分交给我就好了。」
en: “We're checking the instruments and gauze. Every count has to be exact. You can leave this part to me, Miss Nikaido.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你好忙呢，二阶堂小姐。」
en: “You're very busy, Miss Nikaido.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「明明忙的都是你们！可我总觉得，每过一会儿就有人走过来找我……」
en: “You're the ones doing all the work! But it feels like someone comes over to see me every few moments…”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你昨晚不是很怕被大家围着吗？」
en: “Weren't you afraid of being surrounded by everyone last night?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「是啊……可是好奇怪。我还以为会在这张台上紧张两个小时，现在好像没有那么久。」
en: “I was… But it's strange. I thought I'd lie here nervous for two hours. It doesn't seem that long now.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你昨晚怕得那么厉害的事，今天我们可一项都没少做哦。只是每次你快有空害怕了，就又有人来找你。」
en: “We haven't skipped a single thing you were so frightened of last night. It's just that whenever you almost have time to be scared, someone else comes to see you.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「昨天听起来像一部又长又可怕的电影……今天倒有点像大家都在拍同一场戏，只有我还没记住台词。」
en: “Yesterday it sounded like a long, terrifying movie… Today it feels more like everyone's filming the same scene, and I'm the only one who hasn't learned her lines.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你的台词已经背熟啦。姓名、术式，还有哪里不舒服要说出来。剩下的部分，到了时候我们会提醒你的。」
en: “You already know your lines. Your name, your procedure, and telling us if something feels uncomfortable. We'll prompt you for the rest when the time comes.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「噗……你这么说，好像真的是这样。」
en: “Pfft… Put that way, I suppose you're right.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 八点五十分。无菌单已经铺好，蓝色布帘挡住了赖子往腹部看的视线。坂口穿戴妥当，来到台边。
en: Eight fifty. The sterile drapes are in place, and a blue screen blocks Yoriko's view of her abdomen. Sakaguchi, fully dressed for surgery, comes to the table.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「二阶堂小姐，早上好。麻醉情况已经复核，身体有没有不舒服？」
en: “Good morning, Miss Nikaido. We've rechecked the anesthesia. Are you uncomfortable anywhere?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「没有明显疼痛……医生，没想到这么快就见到你了。」
en: “No obvious pain… Doctor, I didn't expect to see you so soon.”

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「快？你已经在手术室里待了将近两个小时了。」
en: “Soon? You've been in the operating room for almost two hours.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「诶？！真的？……我怎么觉得一直有人在跟我说话，一眨眼就过去了！」
en: “What?! Really? …It feels like someone's been talking to me the whole time, and it's gone by in a blink!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口看了看赖子，又看向正替她确认监测和遮盖的朝仓。朝仓眼睛弯弯的，没有解释。
en: Sakaguchi looks at Yoriko, then at Asakura, who is checking her monitors and coverings. Asakura's eyes curve in a smile, but she offers no explanation.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「二阶堂小姐，昨晚说了那么多，到现在你还有问题吗？」
en: “Miss Nikaido, after all we talked about last night, do you still have any questions?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「有啊！比如现在那边是不是已经把刀准备好了，还有……」
en: “I do! Like whether they've already got the scalpel ready over there, and…”

speaker: 旁白
text: 朝仓略微俯身，把声音放低，像在说一个只属于她们两个人的小秘密。
en: Asakura leans down slightly and lowers her voice, as though sharing a secret just between them.

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「你是在紧张，还是在想别的……还是都有一点？」
en: “Are you nervous, or thinking about something else… or a little of both?”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「……都有一点。」
en: “…A little of both.”

speaker: 朝倉美幸
text: 「呵呵。昨晚听到这里，你可是连被子都拉到下巴了。」
en: “Hehe. When we got to this part last night, you pulled the blanket right up to your chin.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「不要在医生面前讲那件事啦！」
en: “Don't tell the doctor about that!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口听见半句，似乎想问她们昨晚聊了什么。朝仓却已直起身，专业地和团队复核身份、术式、麻醉与器械准备。
en: Sakaguchi catches half the exchange and seems about to ask what they discussed last night. But Asakura has already straightened up, professionally checking the identity, procedure, anesthesia and instrument readiness with the team.

speaker: 南条小夜香
text: 「阻滞范围和监测都确认好了。二阶堂小姐，接下来我一直在这里；真觉得疼就立刻告诉我。」
en: “The block and monitoring are confirmed. Miss Nikaido, I'll be here throughout. Tell me immediately if you actually feel pain.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 坂口按照计划在切口周围补充局部浸润麻醉。团队完成最后的时间暂停核对，手术室里响起清楚的回应。
en: As planned, Sakaguchi adds local infiltration around the incision site. The team completes the final time-out checks, their clear responses sounding through the operating room.

speaker: 坂口隆司
text: 「准备完成。二阶堂小姐，我们现在要开始了。」
en: “Preparation is complete. Miss Nikaido, we're going to begin now.”

speaker: 二階堂頼子
en: “Yes, all right… Huh?”

speaker: 中井美佳
text: 「手术刀。」
en: “Scalpel.”

speaker: 旁白
text: 赖子下意识地望向钟。九点整。中井美佳将第一把手术刀递给坂口，蓝色布帘后的医护已经各就各位。
en: Yoriko instinctively looks at the clock. Nine sharp. Mika Nakai passes the first scalpel to Sakaguchi. Behind the blue screen, the medical team is in position.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
text: 「等、等等！现在是真的要下刀了吗？！」
en: “W-wait! Are you really making the incision now?!”

speaker: 旁白
text: 哧拉——。
en: Shrrk—.

speaker: 二階堂頼子
en: “Ugh…”
